title: Lemma 3.9: recognizing p-colimits through the classifying functor
statement_scope: Let p: Str^loc_T(X) -> X be the Cartesian fibration, q: K^> -> Str^loc_T(X) a diagram, and suppose the composite p o q is a colimit diagram in X. Then q is a p-colimit diagram provided the classifying functor chi: X^op -> Cat_inf preserves the relevant small limits, which holds by HTT T.6.1.3.9; the proof invokes HTT VII.5.17 to transfer colimits fiberwise.
